categories.main_business_segments: Changzhou Shichuang Energy Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main segments: photovoltaic (PV) wet process auxiliary materials, photovoltaic equipment, and photovoltaic cells. The company is a platform supplier of new photovoltaic technologies, focusing on original technology development and innovation in materials, equipment, and cells within the PV industry.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies including advanced wet process auxiliary materials for silicon wafer texturing, polishing, cleaning, and etching. It has developed innovative equipment such as defect passivation devices, chain annealing equipment, interface passivation devices, and impurity gettering equipment. The company pioneered half-cell technology utilizing silicon edge scraps and developed original shingled interconnection (叠栅) technology for PV modules, significantly reducing silver consumption and improving efficiency. It also employs advanced N-type TOPCon cell technology and integrates self-developed masking equipment and laser patterning processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves leading domestic and international photovoltaic manufacturers, supplying materials, equipment, and cells tailored to different PV production processes. Its products are widely recognized and used by major PV enterprises, with a strong customer base in both domestic and overseas markets, including key players in the N-type TOPCon and HJT cell segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province, and subsidiaries in other Chinese regions including Hohhot and Hangzhou. It serves both domestic and international markets, with export sales accounting for a portion of revenue. The company’s supply chain and customer base are mainly concentrated in China’s photovoltaic manufacturing hubs.
categories.supply_chain_position: Changzhou Shichuang Energy operates mainly in the midstream segment of the photovoltaic supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying auxiliary materials, production equipment, and photovoltaic cells. It also extends into downstream with photovoltaic module assembly and limited photovoltaic power station operations, including distributed PV projects.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous original technology innovation, focusing on solving manufacturing process challenges to improve efficiency and reduce costs. Strategic R&D priorities include advancing N-type TOPCon cell technology, half-cell technology, shingled interconnection modules, and equipment innovation. It invests heavily in R&D, with a 32.57% R&D-to-revenue ratio in 2024, and holds numerous patents. The company pursues a 'blue ocean strategy' to develop differentiated, high-value products and aims to become a platform supplier providing integrated technical solutions across the PV value chain.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of photovoltaic wet process auxiliary materials, photovoltaic manufacturing equipment, and photovoltaic cells. The company also earns income from photovoltaic module sales and limited power station operations. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales with some distribution channels, serving both domestic and international customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a technology-driven leader and 'hidden champion' in niche segments of the photovoltaic industry, particularly in wet process auxiliary materials and half-cell technology. It competes with other PV material and equipment suppliers, leveraging its strong R&D capabilities and proprietary technologies to maintain market leadership. The industry is highly competitive with rapid technology iteration and price pressures, but the company maintains a leading position in its specialized product lines.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 710.7 million, a 58.93% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to industry-wide price declines and reduced sales volume. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 649 million. Total assets grew by 44.25% to approximately RMB 4.93 billion, driven by investments in a 4GW production project. The company’s R&D investment increased significantly, reflecting its focus on innovation despite financial challenges. The company has about 1,377 employees, with a strong R&D team of 468 members.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Changzhou Shichuang Energy differentiates itself through its deep technical expertise and original innovations in photovoltaic manufacturing processes. Its products address critical process challenges, improving cell efficiency and reducing manufacturing costs. The company’s proprietary half-cell technology and shingled interconnection modules offer unique advantages in material utilization and power output. Its integrated approach combining materials, equipment, and cell technologies enables it to provide comprehensive solutions that enhance customer competitiveness and support industry high-quality development.
